name: Seed a Supabase AI knowledge base from Notion with Ollama embeddings
description: Ingest your entire Notion database into a Supabase vector store for RAG. Fetches full page content, adds titles and source URLs, and syncs automatically on a schedule.

parameters.content:
## Seed a Supabase AI knowledge base from Notion with Ollama embeddings

This n8n template pulls your entire Notion database into a Supabase AI knowledge base, making every page searchable by an AI assistant. Unlike a basic Notion export, it reads the full body content of every page (headings, paragraphs, bullet points, and toggles) and includes each page's title and source URL for more accurate retrieval and citation. Use it as part of a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline to ground AI responses in your actual Notion content: product FAQs, onboarding docs, standard procedures, research notes, and more.

**How it works**
1. Clears the knowledge base before each run so re-runs are always safe and in sync
2. Fetches all pages in your Notion database
3. Retrieves the full block content of each page
4. Skips empty pages
5. Prepends each page's title to its content, appends the source Notion URL, splits into chunks, and generates embeddings using Ollama
6. Stores the embeddings in Supabase, ready for semantic search

**How to use**
1. Follow the Prerequisites sticky note to set up your Notion integration, Supabase table, and credentials in n8n
2. Open the Get Notion Pages node and enter your Notion database ID
3. Click Start Notion Ingestion to populate your knowledge base
4. The Schedule Sync trigger keeps your knowledge base current automatically

**Requirements**
- Supabase account with pgvector enabled
- Notion account with an internal integration connected to your database
- Ollama running locally (ollama.com) with nomic-embed-text pulled

**Customising this workflow**
Swap the Ollama embedding node for OpenAI, Cohere, or HuggingFace. If you switch models, update the vector(768) column in your SQL to match the new dimension. Adjust chunk size and overlap in the Split Text for Processing node to suit your content.

**Pair with:** Seed a Supabase vector store with custom text content (add static reference data) and Build a multi-knowledge base AI assistant with n8n and Supabase (to query everything you have stored).

## Prerequisites

### 1. Notion: create an integration
- Go to https://www.notion.so/my-integrations
- Click "New integration" and give it a name
- Copy the **Internal Integration Token** (you will need it in Step 4)
- In your Notion database, click **Share → Invite your integration**

### 2. Supabase: enable pgvector and create the table

In your Supabase project, open the **SQL Editor** from the left sidebar and run:

```sql
create extension if not exists vector;

create table documents (
  id bigserial primary key,
  content text,
  metadata jsonb,
  embedding vector(768)
);

create or replace function match_documents (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_count int default 5,
  filter jsonb default '{}'
) returns table (
  id bigint,
  content text,
  metadata jsonb,
  similarity float
)
language plpgsql as $$
begin
  return query select
    documents.id,
    documents.content,
    documents.metadata,
    1 - (documents.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from documents
  where documents.metadata @> filter
  order by documents.embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
end;
$$;
```

### 3. Ollama: running locally
- Install Ollama: https://ollama.com
- Pull the embedding model: `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`
- Make sure Ollama is running before executing this workflow

### 4. Add credentials in n8n
In n8n, go to **Settings → Credentials → Add Credential** and create:

**Notion API** (type: Notion API):
- Internal Integration Token → paste the token copied in Step 1

**Supabase** (type: Supabase):
- Host URL → Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → Project URL
- Service Role Secret → same page, under "Project API keys" → service_role

**Ollama** (type: Ollama):
- Base URL → http://localhost:11434

### 5. Connect credentials to nodes
Open each node that shows a credential warning and select the matching credential from the dropdown.

### 6. Configure the Remove Existing Embeddings node
Open the **Remove Existing Embeddings** node and replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_PROJECT_URL` with your Supabase project URL (found in Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → Project URL). Select your Supabase credential from the dropdown. This node runs at the start of every execution and clears all documents from the knowledge base before re-inserting fresh content, so re-running the workflow never creates duplicates.

## Configure Notion

**Find your Database ID:**
Open your Notion database in a browser. The URL looks like:
`https://notion.so/your-workspace/a1b2c3d4e5f6...?v=...`
The long hex string before the `?` is your Database ID.

**In the Get Notion Pages node:**
1. Replace `YOUR_DATABASE_ID` with your actual Database ID
2. Select the Notion credential you created in Prerequisites Step 4

**Make sure your integration has access:**
In Notion → open your database → Share → confirm your integration is listed. If it is not listed, the workflow will return 0 pages.

**Fetch Nested Blocks (optional):**
The **Fetch Page Blocks** node has **Also Fetch Nested Blocks** turned off by default. This keeps the workflow reliable for databases of any size. Turn it on if your pages use toggles or deeply indented lists and your database has fewer than ~40 pages. For larger databases, leave it off to avoid Notion API rate limits.

## Swap the Embedding Model

The default is **nomic-embed-text** (768 dimensions) via Ollama.

**To use a different model**, replace the Generate Embeddings Ollama node:
- **OpenAI** → Embeddings OpenAI (text-embedding-3-small = 1536d)
- **Cohere** → Embeddings Cohere (embed-english-v3.0 = 1024d)
- **HuggingFace** → Embeddings HuggingFace Inference API

**Important:** The embedding dimension must match the `vector(768)` column in your SQL. If you switch models, update the SQL to use the new dimension before running.

## Adjust Chunk Size

The **Split Text for Processing** node controls how content is broken into pieces before embedding.

**Default settings:**
- Chunk size: 500 characters
- Chunk overlap: 50 characters

**When to adjust:**
- Increase chunk size if your content has long, dense paragraphs and context is being cut off
- Decrease chunk size for more precise retrieval on short, factual content
- Increase overlap if retrieved chunks feel disconnected from surrounding context

**Rule of thumb:** smaller chunks = more precise retrieval; larger chunks = more context per result.

## Schedule Your Sync

The **Schedule Sync** trigger runs the ingestion automatically every Monday at 9am.

**To adjust the schedule:**
Open the Schedule Sync node and change the interval, day, or time to suit your needs. Common options: daily, every weekday, or a custom weekly cadence.

**To trigger a manual sync at any time:**
Click **Test workflow** or use the **Start Notion Ingestion** manual trigger. Both triggers run the same ingestion pipeline.

**Re-runs are always safe:**
Each run clears the knowledge base and re-inserts all pages fresh, so your Supabase table always reflects the current state of your Notion database.
